info.name: National Power Portal (NPP) public endpoints
info.description:
Public, unauthenticated endpoints of the National Power Portal (https://npp.gov.in, Central Electricity
Authority) used by the India Energy 2047 project. NPP is one of the two challenge datasets allowed for the
core 2047 prediction. Sources, field meanings and extraction steps: data/raw/npp/SOURCES.md.

Run: npx --yes newman run api/npp.postman_collection.json

Every request waits {{delayMs}} ms first (collection pre-request script). The Merit requests use {{date}}:
"auto" (default) means yesterday in Indian Standard Time; override with --env-var date=YYYY-MM-DD.
The latest daily generation report uses {{dgrDay}} the same way ("auto" = two days before today, IST).

Offline against the recorded responses in api/fixtures: start node api/mock/server.js, then run with
-e api/npp-mock.postman_environment.json. See api/README.md and api/NPP_SERVICES.md.
